Humphrey Sturt, 2nd Baron Alington
Humphrey Napier Sturt, 2nd Baron Alington, KCVO (20 August 1859 – 30 July 1919) was a British peer, the son of Henry Sturt, 1st Baron Alington. He succeeded to the Barony on 17 February 1904.
